scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: Kotlin data class and nullable expression
checks.code:
data class Box(val value: Int)
fun main() { val box: Box? = Box(6); println((box?.value ?: 0) * 2) }

checks.name: Kotlin type error prevents execution
checks.code: fun main() { println("MUST_NOT_RUN"); val n: Int = "wrong"; println(n) }

Exception in thread "main" java.lang.IllegalStateException: intentional error
	at MainKt.main(Main.kt:1)
	at MainKt.main(Main.kt)

checks.name: Kotlin handled exception succeeds
checks.code: fun main() { try { error("expected") } catch (e: IllegalStateException) { println("handled") } }
